title: HGCRS: Hypergraph-Enhanced Generative Conversational Recommender System
abstract: arXiv:2605.21987v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent conversational recommender systems have begun to unify recommendation and response generation within autoregressive models, with semantic IDs providing a natural representation for generative recommendation. However, relational knowledge is typically organized around item-level representations, which do not naturally align with the compositional SIDs. This mismatch makes it difficult for unified CRSs to effectively exploit structured catalog relations. We propose HGCRS, a hypergraph-enhanced generative conversational recommender system that bridges this gap with an SID--entity hypergraph. Each item forms a hyperedge connecting its SID codes and attribute entities, and a type-aware hypergraph encoder incorporates relational information into generative item selection. translated_title: HGCRS：超图增强的生成式对话推荐系统
translated_abstract: 近期的对话推荐系统已开始在自回归模型中统一推荐与回复生成，语义ID（SID）为生成式推荐提供了一种自然的表示方式。然而，关系知识通常围绕物品级表示进行组织，这与组合式的语义ID无法自然对齐。这种不匹配使得统一的对话推荐系统难以有效利用结构化的目录关系。我们提出了HGCRS，一个通过SID—实体超图来弥合这一差距的超图增强生成式对话推荐系统。每个物品形成一条超边，连接其SID编码与属性实体，类型感知的超图编码器将关系信息融入生成式物品选择之中。HGCRS还进一步引入了模式—物品—回复协议，用于联合建模包含推荐意图的轮次和仅回复的轮次。在ReDial和INSPIRED数据集上的实验表明（摘要内容不完整，后续内容缺失）……
tldr: 提出HGCRS，通过SID—实体超图和类型感知超图编码器，将结构化目录关系融入生成式对话推荐系统，弥合了物品级关系知识与组合式语义ID之间的不匹配。
en_tdlr: HGCRS is a hypergraph-enhanced generative conversational recommender system that bridges the mismatch between item-level relational knowledge and compositional semantic IDs through an SID-entity hypergraph with a type-aware hypergraph encoder.
